summary: Section A of the 2026 TICO Texas Statistical Plan establishes general reporting rules for residential property experience, including scope, recording methods, required monthly experience reports, TICO as designated statistical agent, transmittal format, and key premium/loss data fields. It also adds or reiterates specialized reporting for prior claims history, tenure discounts, TWIA depopulation, private flood coverage, replacement cost/roof coverage indicators, cancellation/nonrenewal/declination reason codes, and actual CND counts with MCAS reconciliation expectations.

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Insurance Checking Office
proposed_nodes.notes: Identified in the text as TICO, TDI's designated statistical agent for Texas residential property insurance.

proposed_nodes.name: NAIC
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced for NAIC company number and Market Conduct Annual Statement reconciliation; classified as Regulator under the available closed vocabulary though NAIC is a standards-setting association.

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Windstorm Insurance Association
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced as TWIA for depopulation and assumption reinsurance reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Premiums Report
proposed_nodes.notes: Farm mutuals are not required to report premium records and report zero for these transmittal fields.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Losses Report
proposed_nodes.notes: Farm mutuals are not required to report loss records and report zero for these transmittal fields.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices Report
proposed_nodes.report_name: Dwelling, HO Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices
proposed_nodes.notes: Required for notices related to cancellations, nonrenewals, and declinations effective on or after January 1, 2026, with stated exceptions for pre-2026 applications/policies.

proposed_nodes.name: Dwelling, HO Number of Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations Report
proposed_nodes.report_name: Dwelling, HO Number of Actual Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Declinations
proposed_nodes.notes: Required for cancellations, nonrenewals, and declinations effective on or after January 1, 2026.

proposed_nodes.name: Residential Property Fixed ASCII Standard Data Format Layout
proposed_nodes.layout_name: Residential Property Fixed ASCII Standard Data Format
proposed_nodes.notes: Rule A.29 states that files must be Fixed ASCII: Standard Data Format (SDF).

proposed_nodes.name: Field — NAIC Company Number
proposed_nodes.notes: Must be entered in positions 146–150 for all records.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — TICO Company Number
proposed_nodes.notes: Each reporting carrier must identify each reported record by the Company Number assigned by TICO.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Accounting Date
proposed_nodes.notes: Month and year in which a transaction was recorded on the reporting carrier's books.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.format: five-digit ZIP code; ZIP+4 if available for premium and loss records
proposed_nodes.notes: The five-digit ZIP code of each risk must be reported; ZIP+4 is reported if available for premium and loss records.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Policy Identifier
proposed_nodes.notes: Must uniquely identify the policy and remain consistent each time a given policy is reported.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Claim Identifier
proposed_nodes.notes: Uniquely identifies, with policy identifier and occurrence date, the claim reported in the loss record.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Tenure Code
proposed_nodes.notes: Required in position 140 for all premium and loss transactions for insurers that rate or tier using tenure.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Tenure Discount
proposed_nodes.notes: Required in positions 141–142 for insurers offering a tenure discount; report no discount or tenure tiering only as 00.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Private Flood Coverage Indicator
proposed_nodes.notes: Report indicator 1 for covered homeowner, tenant/condo, and residential fire and EC policies that provide flood or rising waters coverage.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Replacement Cost Building
proposed_nodes.format: replacement cost / actual cash value code per layouts
proposed_nodes.notes: Reports whether main dwelling coverage is on replacement cost or ACV basis, including endorsements.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Replacement Cost Contents
proposed_nodes.format: replacement cost / actual cash value code per layouts
proposed_nodes.notes: Reports whether personal property coverage is on replacement cost or ACV basis, including endorsements.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Roof Coverage Type
proposed_nodes.format: replacement cost / actual cash value code per layouts
proposed_nodes.notes: Reports whether roof coverage is replacement cost or ACV, including endorsements and declining schedule provisions.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Reason Code List
proposed_nodes.notes: Insurer concatenates applicable reason codes in alphabetical order for each cancellation, nonrenewal, or declination.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Recipient Count
proposed_nodes.notes: Shows number of policies or applications for each unique combination in the cancellation/nonrenewal/declination notices report.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Amount of Insurance
proposed_nodes.format: thousands of dollars; policies under $1,500 recorded as 01
proposed_nodes.notes: Limits of liability shown on premium and loss records, generally recorded to the nearest thousand dollars.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — New Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: New claims are reported with 1 in the first loss record; previously reported claims with 0; reversal with -1.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Paid Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: First payment record reports 1; nonpayment and later payment records report 0; paid-claim reversal reports -1.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Reopened Claim Count
proposed_nodes.notes: Newly reopened claim first loss record reports 1; other/not newly reopened records report 0; reversal reports -1.

proposed_nodes.name: Field — Claim Status
proposed_nodes.notes: Reports end-of-month status for new/open/changed claims; codes distinguish never-previously-closed and previously-closed claims.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.description: Enumeration of number of chargeable claims on the policy in the previous five years for insurers using prior claims history as a rating or tiering variable.

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 0
proposed_nodes.description: No chargeable claims in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 1
proposed_nodes.description: One chargeable claim in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 2
proposed_nodes.description: Two chargeable claims in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 3
proposed_nodes.description: Three chargeable claims in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 4
proposed_nodes.description: Four chargeable claims in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 5
proposed_nodes.description: Five or more chargeable claims in the last five years

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History Code 6
proposed_nodes.description: Company does not use prior claims history in rating or tiering

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Tenure Code
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit code for tenure with insurer used for rating or tiering.

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 0
proposed_nodes.description: Tenure not used in rating or tiering

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 1
proposed_nodes.description: 0–2 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 2
proposed_nodes.description: 3–5 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 3
proposed_nodes.description: 6–8 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 4
proposed_nodes.description: 9–10 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 5
proposed_nodes.description: 11–15 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 6
proposed_nodes.description: 16–19 years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Tenure Code 7
proposed_nodes.description: 20 or more years with insurer

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Wind-Only Line of Business Codes
proposed_nodes.description: Line of business codes applicable to wind-only policies in TWIA depopulation reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Wind-Only Line of Business Code 13
proposed_nodes.description: Policies originally issued by TWIA, including policies later assumed by a take-out insurer through assumption reinsurance.

proposed_nodes.name: Wind-Only Line of Business Code 14
proposed_nodes.description: First, second, and third renewal of an assumption reinsurance policy that the take-out insurer is required to renew under Texas Insurance Code §2210.703(a).

proposed_nodes.name: Wind-Only Line of Business Code 15
proposed_nodes.description: All other wind-only policies, including voluntary take-outs under 28 TAC §5.4306, fourth and later renewals of assumption reinsurance policies, and other voluntary-market wind-only policies.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Private Flood Coverage Indicator
proposed_nodes.description: Indicator for whether specified residential policies provide coverage for flood or rising waters.

proposed_nodes.name: Private Flood Coverage Indicator 1
proposed_nodes.description: Policy provides coverage for flood or rising waters, including within the policy or by premium-bearing or nonpremium-bearing endorsement.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes private flood or rising water coverage even if storm surge or wave surge is excluded.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Claim Status
proposed_nodes.description: Codes for claim status at the end of the month, distinguishing never-previously-closed and previously-closed claims.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 1
proposed_nodes.description: Open at end of month; claim has never previously been reported as closed.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 2
proposed_nodes.description: Closed at end of month with indemnity payment; claim has never previously been reported as closed.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 3
proposed_nodes.description: Closed at end of month without indemnity payment; claim has never previously been reported as closed.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes claims with expense-only payments and claims where indemnity payments were fully recovered from the insured.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 4
proposed_nodes.description: Open at end of month; claim has previously been reported as closed.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 5
proposed_nodes.description: Closed at end of month with indemnity payment; claim has previously been reported as closed.

proposed_nodes.name: Claim Status Code 6
proposed_nodes.description: Closed at end of month without indemnity payment; claim has previously been reported as closed.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes claims with expense-only payments and claims where indemnity payments were fully recovered from the insured.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage Type — Dwelling
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance reporting includes Dwelling for homeowners and dwelling forms and Dwelling for condominium forms where applicable.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage Type — Personal Property
proposed_nodes.notes: Amount of insurance reporting includes Personal Property for homeowners/dwelling, tenant, and condominium forms.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage Type — Loss of Use / Additional Living Expense
proposed_nodes.notes: Carriers report Loss of Use as a dollar limit, converting percentage-of-Coverage-A limits to dollars; report only dollar limit when a time limit also applies.
proposed_nodes.coverage_name: Loss of Use / Additional Living Expense

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage Type — Private Flood / Rising Waters
proposed_nodes.notes: Report private flood policies only; federal flood policies written through NFIP Write Your Own and stand-alone excess flood policies are excluded.

proposed_nodes.name: Annual Reconciliation to TDI Designated Statistical Agent
proposed_nodes.notes: Rule A.21 requires reporting carriers, including farm mutuals, to submit a reconciliation once a year; source report is not specified in this section.

proposed_nodes.name: Actual Cancellations and Nonrenewals Reconciliation to NAIC MCAS
proposed_nodes.notes: Rule A.35 says actual cancellation and nonrenewal counts should reconcile with counts provided to NAIC for MCAS.
proposed_nodes.against_target: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement (MCAS) for cancellations and nonrenewals
